column1: # The figure index: one row per drawing of dark.tsv. scripts/archify.sh site groups the pages by it,
# scripts/archify_dress.py stamps the `ww3` text under each picture (PNG, PDF and page), and
# tests/test_archify_index.py fails when a drawing has no row, a row has no stamp, or a page or a
# group does not exist. Facts for the website (ADR-0024): piabrota/nix-os may read this file.
# slug: docs/archify/<slug>.json; lang: en or pt-BR; group: a row of groups.tsv; twin: the same
# drawing in the other language, or empty; page: the repository page the figure illustrates, with
# its anchor; question: the one question the figure answers; ww3: the WAVEWATCH III the figure is
# drawn from, printed under the picture. The default names the reference --ww3 (MetOcean
# metocean/WW3, tag 7.14.mos-92e2cf6, VERSION 7.14) and the fork the port lives on (WW3/ at
# 96892c95, on NOAA-EMC/WW3 03adda91, VERSION 7.14); a drawing whose Fortran lines were read at
# another commit names that commit instead.
